work.description: The act answers King Victor Emmanuel II on the civil-marriage bill (printed as document LI). Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF154-158) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF13015-13015 reads: Datum Castri Gandulphi die 19 septembris 1852. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
